repairs.problem: The 24 exact governorate population claims cited rounded INS Volume 0; Sousse, Nabeul and Kairouan also contradicted the exact Volume 3 table.
actions: Changed the atomic source to INS RGPH 2014 Volume 3, PDF page 47.
Corrected Sousse from 674971 to 674818, Nabeul from 787920 to 787918, and Kairouan from 570559 to 570436.
Added page-and-row locators to all 24 claims and updated deterministic migration/import inputs and the snapshot checksum.

repairs.problem: Every Sidi Bou Saïd citation used unrelated World Heritage property 1732, and the sampled period value was not supported by the correct property.
actions: Changed all locators to World Heritage property 1769.
Replaced the unsupported period with the sourced 13th-century development around the Sufi master's tomb.
Replaced the condition wording with source-exact village/environment wording and corrected the point to property 1769.

repairs.problem: The Ibn Khaldun source record pointed to adjacent article pf0000068103 rather than the article supporting both published claims.
actions: Changed the source to pf0000068104, Tradition and experiment in Arabic letters, January 1986, pp. 17–18.
Added p. 17 locators to the entity, aliases, relationship and both claims.

repairs.problem: Three populated-place classifications confused current places with heritage or archaeological descriptions.
actions: Replaced current Sousse town with ONTT-sourced city ENT-TN-CITY-SOUSSE.
Replaced El Jem settlement with UNESCO-sourced village ENT-TN-VILLAGE-EL-JEM.
Moved Magon from current neighborhood to archaeological site ENT-TN-SITE-MAGON under the separate Carthage site entity.
Removed the validator rule that forced six different populated-place types; the bounded pilot now follows source evidence.

repairs.problem: ONTT or heritage-site locators did not establish stored populated-place/market coordinates.
actions: Removed unsupported points from Carthage city, Sousse city, El Jem village, Magon archaeological quarter and the Tunis medina market.
Kept only points traceable to the represented entity and source; corrected Sidi Bou Saïd to the property 1769 point.

repairs.problem: Sejnane pottery and Kerkennah charfia were attributed to legal municipalities although UNESCO described village/community or island/community scope.
actions: Created bounded village ENT-TN-VILLAGE-SEJNANE and moved the pottery claim to it.
Created geographic island-group ENT-TN-NATURAL-SITE-KERKENNAH-ISLANDS and moved the charfia claim to it.
Updated the cultural domain ledger; no national claim was copied downward.

workflow_repair: make repair now preserves curated atomic sources, runs the Tunisia Phase 2 importer after legacy migration, and generates pages from repaired structured data.
